arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. Goal fastest finish. Settle after the hard start to about 200-205 W shaft (pod CP 195 W, reserve 15.6 kJ spread over ~50 min adds ~5 W). Check CP with heart rate: steady below CP levels off, above CP keeps climbing. Keep ~40-60 % of the pod reserve for the last 1.5 km, finish cue at about 1000 m to go. Watch for drag/weed (GPS speed falls at same pod power, boat-model power falls), pod drift (pod power moves but HR and boat power do not), radio messages about the course. Spend few cues.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m (odd legs OUT against ~0.14 m/s current+wind, even legs BACK with it). Hull fit clean (share 0.60). Paddler went out far too hot, blew up at 9.3 min, now riding at ~CP (195-200 W pod) with the pod reserve near 0. Paddler ignores most cues (ease, piece, pace target, 2nd rate_down all ignored); tell of true distance at 17 min was followed by a drop 206->194 W (maybe). Goal now: avoid a second blow-up (keep pod at or just under 195 W so some reserve rebuilds), then finish cue at ~800-1000 m to go with whatever reserve there is. Use cues sparingly; re-test which ask type works only when the paddler surges above ~207 W.
